seo_title: Christmas Events for Kids in Orange, CA 2026
seo_desc: Christmas events for kids in Orange, California for 2026: Santa's Village and the Christmas Train at Irvine Park, the OC Zoo and Old Towne tree lighting.
lede: Orange celebrates Christmas around Old Towne Plaza and Irvine Regional Park, where a railroad, a zoo and a free Santa's Village share one park.
celebrates: Orange's Christmas season splits between Old Towne and Irvine Regional Park. Orange Plaza Traditions holds a Christmas Market and Tree Lighting Ceremony on the plaza with a candlelight procession. At Irvine Regional Park, Irvine Park Railroad runs the Christmas Train to a North Pole and keeps Santa's Village open with free entry, while OC Parks hosts Christmas at the OC Zoo with Santa, story time and crafts. The Orange Public Library and History Center brings Santa to its Community Room, and the Villa Park Library, next door, runs free holiday craft programs.
lastyear: OC Parks held Christmas at the OC Zoo in December 2025 on Saturday, December 13, from 10 am to 3 pm, according to its holiday news release. Families visited Santa and Mrs. Claus, made holiday crafts for kids and watched zoo animals receive treat filled gifts hidden inside Christmas trees, with activities included in $2 zoo admission. In 2026 the zoo event moves to Saturday, December 12, with the same hours and the same $2 admission.
facts: Orange Plaza Traditions says its mission is to positively impact the community through partnerships, leadership and service. The group also produces the Orange International Street Fair and Treats in the Streets, so the December tree lighting is one of three annual plaza events it runs. Irvine Park Railroad's Santa's Village sits behind the train station, with its entrance to the right of the station building.
trains: Irvine Park Railroad at Irvine Regional Park, 1 Irvine Park Road, runs the Christmas Train, which takes guests to a North Pole to visit Santa, and tickets must be bought in advance. Its Santa's Village next to the station is free to enter and open November 27 to December 30. The railroad also runs a Train of Lights, and its activity tickets cannot be used on either train, according to its own site.
traditions: Orange Plaza Traditions' December 6 market, candlelight procession and tree lighting.
Irvine Park Railroad's North Pole train and its free village of lights.
OC Parks' day of Santa, crafts and animals opening treat filled gifts.
The Orange Public Library and History Center's free Santa visit and letter drop.
kidfact: At the OC Zoo, the animals get presents too, hidden inside Christmas trees.
faq: Can kids ride a Christmas train in Orange?
Yes. Irvine Park Railroad runs the Christmas Train, which takes guests to a North Pole to visit Santa. Tickets must be purchased in advance, according to the railroad.
Is Santa's Village at Irvine Park free?
Entry is free and no reservations are required. Activities use $8 tickets, according to Irvine Park Railroad.
Where is the Orange tree lighting?
Orange Plaza Traditions holds the Tree Lighting Ceremony on Sunday, December 6, 2026, with a candlelight procession starting at 5:15 pm.
Does the OC Zoo do Christmas events?
Yes. Christmas at the OC Zoo is Saturday, December 12, 2026, from 10 am to 3 pm with Santa, Mrs. Claus, crafts and treat filled gifts for the animals.
Is there a free Santa visit in Orange?
The Orange Public Library and History Center lists Here Comes Santa Claus on December 8 from 6 to 7:30 pm as a free event.

intro_html:
Rally the corgi has sniffed out the best Christmas events for kids in Orange for 2026, and here is what he found: 7 family events across Orange and 1 nearby town, 4 of them free. The magic runs from November 27 (Christmas Train at Irvine Park Railroad and Santa's Village at Irvine Park Railroad) through December 30, with Carolers and Crafts in Villa Park (December 2), the Old Towne Orange Christmas Market and Tree Lighting Ceremony (December 6) and Christmas at the OC Zoo (December 12) along the way. We check every date on the host's own website, and each listing links straight there.

What Rally found in Orange

  • 7 Christmas events for kids in Orange and Villa Park
  • 4 free events: Santa's Village at Irvine Park Railroad (free entry), Here Comes Santa Claus at the Orange Public Library and the two Villa Park Library craft programs
  • Meet Santa: Santa's Village and the Christmas Train at Irvine Park Railroad, Christmas at the OC Zoo (December 12) and Here Comes Santa Claus at the library (December 8)
  • Parades and tree lightings: Old Towne Orange Christmas Market and Tree Lighting Ceremony (December 6)
  • Trains: Christmas Train at Irvine Park Railroad (November 27 to December 23)
  • Season: November 27 to December 30

Planning a bigger day out? Orange families also use our guide to Christmas activities for kids in Anaheim, which covers Holidays at the Disneyland Resort, the Nutcracker Holiday Village and Tree Lighting in Downtown Anaheim and Monster Jam Christmas Chaos at Angel Stadium.
